eyebrow: Step 1 · Estimate with FAIR, not a 5x5 matrix
code:
Risk: Unauthorized access to the CDE via a
      compromised privileged credential

Loss Event Frequency (LEF): 0.1 - 0.4 / year
Probable Loss Magnitude (PLM): $180,000 - $2,100,000

Two ranges, not two point guesses.
caption: FAIR asks for a range on both sides -- not a 1-5 score on a heat map.

eyebrow: Step 2 · A number a CFO can actually use
code:
ALE (low)  = 0.1 x $180,000   =  $18,000
ALE (high) = 0.4 x $2,100,000 = $840,000

Hardware-key MFA costs $40,000/year to run.

Clearly justified against an ALE floor of $18,000
that can climb to $840,000.
caption: Annualized Loss Expectancy turns the estimate into a budget argument.
